CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.butcher_stock_factor(p_base text, p_selected text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_base=p_selected THEN 1::numeric
 WHEN p_base IN('kg','g') AND p_selected IN('kg','g') THEN
  (CASE p_selected WHEN 'kg' THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END)::numeric/(CASE p_base WHEN 'kg' THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END)
 WHEN p_base IN('carcass','half','quarter') AND p_selected IN('carcass','half','quarter') THEN
  (CASE p_selected WHEN 'carcass' THEN 1 WHEN 'half' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.25 END)/(CASE p_base WHEN 'carcass' THEN 1 WHEN 'half' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.25 END)
 ELSE NULL END
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'brandName',c.name,'cafeId',c.id,'number',d.number,'createdAt',d.created_at,'localReference',d.local_reference,
  'subtotal',d.subtotal,'discount',d.discount,'tax',d.tax,'total',d.total,'paid',coalesce((state.value->>'paid')::numeric,d.paid),
  'customerPhone',d.customer_phone,'customerName',p.name,'customerTaxNumber',p.tax_number,

  'refundedTotal',state.value->'refunded_total',

  'lines',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',l.name,'quantity',l.quantity,

 FROM public.bf_documents d JOIN public.cafes c ON c.id=d.cafe_id

 LEFT JOIN public.bf_parties p ON p.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND p.id=d.party_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.customer_timeline(p_cafe uuid, p_customer uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, kind text, action text, event_at timestamp with time zone, actor_id uuid, document_id uuid, quote_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT 'document:'||d.id,d.kind,CASE d.kind WHEN 'sale' THEN 'إنشاء فاتورة' WHEN 'settlement' THEN 'تسجيل دفعة' ELSE 'تسجيل مرتجع' END,d.created_at,d.created_by,d.id,NULL::uuid
 FROM public.bf_documents d WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe AND d.party_id=p_customer AND d.kind IN('sale','settlement','refund')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'activity:'||a.id,'activity',a.action,a.created_at,a.created_by,a.document_id,NULL::uuid
 FROM public.bf_invoice_activity a JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND d.id=a.document_id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe AND d.party_id=p_customer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'quote-created:'||q.id,'quote','إنشاء عرض سعر',q.created_at,q.created_by,NULL::uuid,q.id
 FROM public.bf_quotes q WHERE q.cafe_id=p_cafe AND q.payload#>>'{document,invoice,partyId}'=p_customer::text
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'quote-updated:'||q.id,'quote','تحديث عرض سعر',q.updated_at,q.updated_by,NULL::uuid,q.id
 FROM public.bf_quotes q WHERE q.cafe_id=p_cafe AND q.payload#>>'{document,invoice,partyId}'=p_customer::text AND q.updated_at>q.created_at
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'message:'||m.id,'message',CASE WHEN m.provider_status='read' THEN 'قراءة رسالة الفاتورة' WHEN m.provider_status='delivered' THEN 'تسليم رسالة الفاتورة' WHEN m.provider_status='sent' THEN 'إرسال رسالة الفاتورة' ELSE 'قبول إرسال رسالة الفاتورة' END,coalesce(m.provider_confirmed_at,m.finished_at,m.created_at),NULL::uuid,d.id,NULL::uuid
 FROM public.bf_customer_message_jobs m JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=m.cafe_id AND d.id=m.document_id
 WHERE m.cafe_id=p_cafe AND d.party_id=p_customer AND (m.state='queued' OR m.provider_status IN('sent','delivered','read'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.document_state(p_cafe uuid, p_doc uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('paid',d.paid,'account_id',d.account_id,
  'outstanding',CASE WHEN d.kind IN('sale','purchase') THEN greatest(d.total-d.paid-coalesce(s.paid,0)-coalesce(r.total,0)+coalesce(r.paid,0),0) ELSE 0 END,
  'refunded_total',coalesce(r.total,0),'refunded_paid',coalesce(r.paid,0),
  'refunded',d.kind IN('sale','purchase') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(brand_finance_private.refund_lines(p_cafe,p_doc,false)) l WHERE (l->>'returned_quantity')::numeric<(l->>'quantity')::numeric),
  'reference_number',(SELECT number FROM public.bf_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe AND id=d.reference_id))
  ||coalesce((SELECT jsonb_build_object('display_number',e.display_number,'document_type',CASE WHEN e.source_id IS NULL THEN 'invoice' ELSE 'debit' END,'currency',coalesce(e.metadata->>'currency','SAR')) FROM public.bf_invoice_extensions e WHERE e.cafe_id=p_cafe AND e.document_id=d.id),'{}'::jsonb)
 ||CASE WHEN d.kind='settlement' THEN jsonb_build_object('total',d.total) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
 FROM (SELECT (brand_finance_private.payment_document(raw)).* FROM public.bf_documents raw WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe AND id=p_doc) d
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT sum(total) total,sum(paid) paid FROM public.bf_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe AND reference_id=d.id AND kind='refund') r ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT sum((brand_finance_private.payment_document(payment)).total) paid FROM public.bf_documents payment WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe AND reference_id=d.id AND kind='settlement') s ON true
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.refund_lines_before_purchase_debits(p_cafe uuid, p_doc uuid, p_managed boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH legacy AS (
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_documents r JOIN public.bf_document_lines rl ON rl.document_id=r.id AND rl.cafe_id=r.cafe_id WHERE r.cafe_id=p_cafe AND r.reference_id=p_doc AND r.kind='refund' AND rl.reference_line_id IS NULL) AS full_return
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)-'cafe_id'-'document_id'||jsonb_build_object(
  'returned_quantity',CASE WHEN legacy.full_return THEN l.quantity ELSE coalesce(r.qty,0) END,
  'returned_net',CASE WHEN legacy.full_return THEN l.net ELSE coalesce(r.net,0) END,
  'returned_tax',CASE WHEN legacy.full_return THEN l.tax ELSE coalesce(r.tax,0) END,
  'returned_cost',CASE WHEN NOT p_managed THEN 0 WHEN legacy.full_return THEN l.cost ELSE coalesce(r.cost,0) END
 )||CASE WHEN p_managed THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE '{"cost":0,"allocated_cost":0}'::jsonb END ORDER BY l.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM public.bf_document_lines l CROSS JOIN legacy LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(rl.quantity) qty,sum(rl.net) net,sum(rl.tax) tax,sum(rl.cost) cost
  FROM public.bf_document_lines rl JOIN public.bf_documents rd ON rd.id=rl.document_id AND rd.cafe_id=rl.cafe_id
  WHERE rl.cafe_id=p_cafe AND rl.reference_line_id=l.id AND rd.reference_id=p_doc AND rd.kind='refund'
 ) r ON true WHERE l.cafe_id=p_cafe AND l.document_id=p_doc

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.shipping_charge_selection(p_selection jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_selection IS NULL OR p_selection='null'::jsonb THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_selection) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'راجع رسوم الشحن' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_selection))<>4 OR NOT p_selection ?& ARRAY['optionId','name','amount','taxRate']
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_selection->'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR length(btrim(p_selection->>'name')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 160
 OR NOT brand_finance_private.invoice_number_valid(p_selection->'amount',0,10000000,2)
 OR (p_selection->'taxRate'<>'null'::jsonb AND p_selection->'taxRate'<>'15'::jsonb)
 OR (p_selection->'optionId'<>'null'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof(p_selection->'optionId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR p_selection->>'optionId' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'راجع خيار الشحن ومبلغه وضريبته' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('optionId',(p_selection->>'optionId')::uuid,'name',btrim(p_selection->>'name'),'amount',(p_selection->>'amount')::numeric,'taxRate',(p_selection->>'taxRate')::numeric);

AS $function$
DECLARE r text; managed boolean; answer jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_snapshot',NULL);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_cafe_id::text,60412));
 r:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id); managed:=r IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor','warehouse');

  'cafe',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'slug',slug,'businessCategory',business_category) FROM public.cafes WHERE id=p_cafe_id),
  'userId',auth.uid(),'role',r,'canManage',managed,'canAdminister',r='owner',
  'settings',(SELECT to_jsonb(s)-'cafe_id' FROM public.bf_settings s WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'accounts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('availableWithoutShift',a.is_cashier_drawer AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_shifts held WHERE held.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND held.account_id=a.id AND held.status IN('open','handover')),'balance',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.account_id=a.id),0) ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY a.code) FROM public.bf_accounts a WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (managed OR kind IN('cash','bank','pos'))),'[]'::jsonb),
  'parties',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(p)-'cafe_id'-CASE WHEN managed THEN '__internal_none__' ELSE 'details' END)||jsonb_build_object('balance',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN p.kind='supplier' THEN j.credit-j.debit ELSE j.debit-j.credit END) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.party_id=p.id AND a.kind=CASE p.kind WHEN 'customer' THEN 'receivable' WHEN 'supplier' THEN 'payable' ELSE 'employee' END),0) ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY p.name) FROM public.bf_parties p WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (managed OR kind='customer')),'[]'::jsonb),
  'warehouses',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY w.name) FROM public.bf_warehouses w WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'products',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.name,'price',p.price,'butcherDetails',p.butcher_details,'imageUrl',p.image_url,'imageStoragePath',p.image_storage_path,'category',coalesce(c.name,''),'available',p.available,'stockTracked',i.id IS NOT NULL,'itemId',i.id,'quantity',coalesce((SELECT sum(quantity) FROM public.bf_stock WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND item_id=i.id),0)) ORDER BY p.sort_order,p.name) FROM public.menu_products p LEFT JOIN public.menu_categories c ON c.id=p.category_id AND c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id LEFT JOIN public.bf_items i ON i.menu_product_id=p.id AND i.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND i.active WHERE p.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb),
  'items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('quantity',coalesce((SELECT sum(quantity) FROM public.bf_stock WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND item_id=i.id),0),'average_cost',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(quantity*average_cost)/nullif(sum(quantity),0) FROM public.bf_stock WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND item_id=i.id),0) ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY i.name) FROM public.bf_items i WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'stock',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-'cafe_id'-'value'||CASE WHEN managed THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE '{"average_cost":0}'::jsonb END) FROM public.bf_stock s WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'documents',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)-'cafe_id'||brand_finance_private.document_state(p_cafe_id,d.id)||jsonb_build_object('lines',brand_finance_private.refund_lines(p_cafe_id,d.id,managed)) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.bf_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (managed OR (created_by=auth.uid() AND kind='sale') OR (kind='refund' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_refund_requests rr WHERE rr.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND rr.refund_document_id=bf_documents.id AND rr.created_by=auth.uid()))) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 500) d),'[]'::jsonb),
  'refundRequests',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rr)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC,rr.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.bf_refund_requests WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (managed OR created_by=auth.uid()) ORDER BY (status='pending') DESC,created_at DESC LIMIT 500) rr),'[]'::jsonb),
  'shifts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('expected_cash',CASE WHEN s.status='closed' THEN s.expected_cash ELSE coalesce((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.account_id=s.account_id),0) END) ORDER BY opened_at DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.bf_shifts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (managed OR user_id=auth.uid() OR handover_to=auth.uid()) ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 200) s),'[]'::jsonb),
  'staff',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-'cafe_id') FROM public.bf_staff s WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (managed OR active)),'[]'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_array((SELECT jsonb_build_object('user_id',owner_user_id,'name','مالك العلامة','role','manager','active',true) FROM public.cafes WHERE id=p_cafe_id)),
  'journal',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)-'cafe_id'-'party_id' ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.bf_journal WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 2000) j),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
  'movements',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.bf_movements WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 1000) m),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
  'trialBalance',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('account_id',a.id,'name',a.name,'kind',a.kind,'debit',coalesce(j.debit,0),'credit',coalesce(j.credit,0),'balance',coalesce(j.debit-j.credit,0)) ORDER BY a.code) FROM public.bf_accounts a LEFT JOIN(SELECT account_id,sum(debit) debit,sum(credit) credit FROM public.bf_journal WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id GROUP BY account_id) j ON j.account_id=a.id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
  'summary',jsonb_build_object('salesGross',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.kind='sale' THEN d.total ELSE -d.total END) FROM public.bf_documents d LEFT JOIN public.bf_documents orig ON orig.id=d.reference_id AND orig.cafe_id=d.cafe_id WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (d.kind='sale' OR (d.kind='refund' AND orig.kind='sale'))),0) ELSE 0 END,'salesTax',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.kind='sale' THEN d.tax ELSE -d.tax END) FROM public.bf_documents d LEFT JOIN public.bf_documents orig ON orig.id=d.reference_id AND orig.cafe_id=d.cafe_id WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (d.kind='sale' OR (d.kind='refund' AND orig.kind='sale'))),0) ELSE 0 END,'sales',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.credit-j.debit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.kind='revenue'),0) ELSE 0 END,'otherIncome',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.credit-j.debit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.kind='revenue' AND a.code<>'4000'),0) ELSE 0 END,'purchases',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.kind='purchase' THEN d.total ELSE -d.total END) FROM public.bf_documents d LEFT JOIN public.bf_documents orig ON orig.id=d.reference_id WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (d.kind='purchase' OR (d.kind='refund' AND orig.kind='purchase'))),0) ELSE 0 END,'expenses',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.kind='expense'),0) ELSE 0 END,'profit',0,'receivables',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.kind='receivable' AND a.code<>'1190'),0) ELSE 0 END,'payables',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.credit-j.debit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.kind='payable' AND a.code<>'2010'),0) ELSE 0 END,'inventoryValue',CASE WHEN managed THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(value) FROM public.bf_stock WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),0) ELSE 0 END),
  'truncated',(SELECT count(*)>500 FROM public.bf_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id) OR (SELECT count(*)>2000 FROM public.bf_journal WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id)
 ) INTO answer;
 answer:=jsonb_set(answer,'{summary,profit}',to_jsonb((answer#>>'{summary,sales}')::numeric-(answer#>>'{summary,expenses}')::numeric));
 answer:=jsonb_set(answer,'{summary,sales}',to_jsonb((answer#>>'{summary,salesGross}')::numeric-(answer#>>'{summary,salesTax}')::numeric));
 RETURN answer;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.validate_order_source_settings(p_settings jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE source jsonb; default_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_settings) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR octet_length(p_settings::text)>50000
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_settings))<>4
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_settings) k WHERE k NOT IN('sources','defaultMode','defaultSourceId','required'))
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_settings->'sources') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_settings->'sources')>100
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_settings->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    OR coalesce(p_settings->>'defaultMode','') NOT IN('none','last','specific')
    OR (p_settings->'defaultSourceId'<>'null'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof(p_settings->'defaultSourceId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR p_settings->>'defaultSourceId' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'راجع خيارات مصادر الطلب والحد الأقصى ١٠٠ مصدر' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  FOR source IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_settings->'sources') LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(source) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(source))<>3
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(source) k WHERE k NOT IN('id','name','active'))
      OR coalesce(source->>'id','') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      OR jsonb_typeof(source->'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(length(btrim(source->>'name')),0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 80
      OR source->>'name'<>btrim(source->>'name') OR jsonb_typeof(source->'active') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'راجع اسم مصدر الطلب وحالته' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_settings->'sources') s GROUP BY (s->>'id')::uuid HAVING count(*)>1)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_settings->'sources') s GROUP BY lower(s->>'name') HAVING count(*)>1)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اسم مصدر الطلب ومعرفه يجب ألا يتكررا' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  default_id:=(p_settings->>'defaultSourceId')::uuid;
  IF (p_settings->>'defaultMode'='specific' AND (default_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_settings->'sources') s WHERE (s->>'id')::uuid=default_id AND (s->>'active')::boolean)))
    OR (p_settings->>'defaultMode'<>'specific' AND default_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR ((p_settings->>'required')::boolean AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_settings->'sources') s WHERE (s->>'active')::boolean))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر مصدرًا نشطًا للإعداد الافتراضي أو الإلزامي' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_access_private.snapshot_erp_tasks_read(p_cafe_id uuid, p_query jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r text; v_page integer:=coalesce((p_query->>'page')::integer,1); v_query text:=coalesce(p_query->>'query',''); v_id uuid:=nullif(p_query->>'id','')::uuid; v_flow uuid:=nullif(p_query->>'flowId','')::uuid; result jsonb;
BEGIN PERFORM erp_access_private.assert_allowed(p_cafe_id,'tasks','read');
 r:=erp_task_private.access(p_cafe_id);
 IF v_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 OR length(v_query)>120 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'معايير البحث غير صالحة' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT t.*,ty.name type_name,erp_task_private.staff_name(p_cafe_id,t.assignee_id) assignee_name,erp_task_private.target_name(p_cafe_id,t.target_kind,t.target_id) target_name
  FROM erp_branch_private.erp_tasks t JOIN erp_branch_private.erp_task_types ty ON ty.cafe_id=t.cafe_id AND ty.id=t.type_id
  WHERE t.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND erp_task_private.task_visible(p_cafe_id,t.id)AND (v_query='' OR t.title ILIKE '%'||v_query||'%' OR t.code ILIKE '%'||v_query||'%')
   AND (coalesce(p_query->>'status','')='' OR t.status=p_query->>'status') AND (coalesce(p_query->>'priority','')='' OR t.priority=p_query->>'priority')
   AND (nullif(p_query->>'typeId','') IS NULL OR t.type_id=(p_query->>'typeId')::uuid) AND (nullif(p_query->>'assigneeId','') IS NULL OR t.assignee_id=(p_query->>'assigneeId')::uuid)
   AND (v_id IS NULL OR t.id=v_id) AND (v_flow IS NULL OR t.flow_id=v_flow)
 ), paged AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY CASE WHEN p_query->>'sort'='title' THEN title END ASC, CASE WHEN p_query->>'sort'='due' THEN due_date END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN p_query->>'sort'='oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,created_at DESC,id LIMIT CASE WHEN v_flow IS NULL THEN 50 ELSE 100 END OFFSET (v_page-1)*50)

 RETURN result||jsonb_build_object(
  'types',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY name) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_task_types t WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'::jsonb),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_accounting_private.gl_report(p_cafe_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date, p_account_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE start_at timestamptz; end_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  PERFORM erp_accounting_private.authorize(p_cafe_id);
  IF brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا تملك صلاحية قراءة التقرير' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_from) OR NOT isfinite(p_to) OR p_to<p_from OR p_to-p_from>3660
    OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset<0 OR p_offset>1000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حدد فترة تقرير صالحة'; END IF;
  IF p_account_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=p_account_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الحساب غير موجود'; END IF;
  start_at:=p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'; end_at:=(p_to+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'accountId',p_account_id,'offset',p_offset,
    'generatedAt',now(),'currency','SAR',
    'balances',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(b) ORDER BY code) FROM (
      SELECT a.id,a.code,a.name,a.kind,a.parent_id,a.is_group,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit-j.credit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at<start_at),0) opening,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at>=start_at),0) debit,
        coalesce(sum(j.credit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at>=start_at),0) credit,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit-j.credit),0) closing
      FROM public.bf_accounts a LEFT JOIN public.bf_journal j ON j.account_id=a.id AND j.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND j.created_at<end_at
      WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR a.id=p_account_id) GROUP BY a.id
    ) b),'[]'),
    'entries',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(e) ORDER BY created_at,id) FROM (
      SELECT j.id,j.document_id,j.account_id,j.debit,j.credit,j.created_at,j.memo,a.name account_name,a.code,d.number,d.kind,d.reference_id
      FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id
      JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND d.id=j.document_id
      WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.created_at>=start_at AND j.created_at<end_at AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR j.account_id=p_account_id)
      ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id OFFSET p_offset LIMIT 100
    ) e),'[]'),
    'hasMore',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_journal j WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.created_at>=start_at AND j.created_at<end_at
      AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR j.account_id=p_account_id) OFFSET p_offset+100 LIMIT 1));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_attendance_private.selected(p_cafe uuid, p jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result uuid[];BEGIN
 IF coalesce(p->>'mode','') NOT IN('rules','employees') OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p->'employeeIds','[]'))>500 OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p->'excludeIds','[]'))>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'معايير اختيار الموظفين غير صالحة';END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(e.id ORDER BY e.code) INTO result FROM public.erp_hr_employees e WHERE e.cafe_id=p_cafe AND e.active
 AND NOT coalesce(p->'excludeIds'?e.id::text,false)

 (jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p->'branchIds','[]'))=0 OR p->'branchIds'?e.branch_id::text)

AS $function$
DECLARE s integer:=erp_attendance_private.minute(p->>'start');e integer:=erp_attendance_private.minute(p->>'end');a integer;b integer;c integer;d integer;breaks integer:=coalesce((p->>'breakMinutes')::integer,0);grace integer:=coalesce((p->>'grace')::integer,0);BEGIN

 SELECT a.center_id,(v.payload->>'date')::date dated,CASE WHEN v.kind='expense' THEN a.base_amount ELSE 0 END expense,CASE WHEN v.kind='receipt' THEN a.base_amount ELSE 0 END income FROM public.erp_finance_cost_allocations a JOIN public.erp_finance_vouchers v ON v.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND v.id=a.voucher_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(v.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND v.document_id IS NOT NULL AND ac.kind IN('expense','revenue')
 UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date,CASE WHEN v.kind='expense' THEN -a.base_amount ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN v.kind='receipt' THEN -a.base_amount ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_finance_cost_allocations a JOIN public.erp_finance_vouchers v ON v.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND v.id=a.voucher_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=v.cafe_id AND d.id=v.reversal_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(v.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND ac.kind IN('expense','revenue')
 UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,m.effective_on,a.base_amount,0 FROM public.erp_finance_custody_costs a JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements m ON m.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND m.id=a.movement_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(m.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND ac.kind='expense'
 UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,r.effective_on,-a.base_amount,0 FROM public.erp_finance_custody_costs a JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements m ON m.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND m.id=a.movement_id JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements r ON r.cafe_id=m.cafe_id AND r.reversal_of=m.id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(m.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND ac.kind='expense')
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]') INTO answer FROM(SELECT c.id AS "centerId",c.name,coalesce(sum(m.expense),0) expenses,coalesce(sum(m.income),0) receipts FROM public.erp_cost_centers c JOIN centers x ON c.id=x.id LEFT JOIN moves m ON m.center_id=c.id AND m.dated BETWEEN p_from AND p_to WHERE c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY c.name)q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'rows',answer,'basis','posted_net_excluding_vat');
END $function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE r text;answer jsonb;o integer:=coalesce((p_query->>'offset')::integer,0);BEGIN
 r:=erp_finance_private.authorize(p_cafe_id);PERFORM brand_finance_private.seed(p_cafe_id);IF o<0 OR o>1000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'صفحة غير صالحة';END IF;
 answer:=jsonb_build_object(
 'vouchers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY created_at DESC) FROM(SELECT * FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_vouchers WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND(coalesce(p_query->>'kind','')='' OR kind=p_query->>'kind') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET o)v),'[]'),
 'voucherTotal',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_vouchers WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND(coalesce(p_query->>'kind','')='' OR kind=p_query->>'kind')),
 'custodies',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('remainingBase',erp_finance_private.balance(p_cafe_id,account_id),'remaining',round(erp_finance_private.balance(p_cafe_id,account_id)/(payload->>'exchangeRate')::numeric,2)) ORDER BY created_at DESC) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_custodies v WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'categories',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY name) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_categories v WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'statements',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('rows',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_bank_statement_rows x WHERE x.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND x.statement_id=v.id),'unmatched',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_bank_statement_rows x WHERE x.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND x.statement_id=v.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erp_branch_private.erp_bank_matches m WHERE m.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND m.row_id=x.id))) ORDER BY created_at DESC) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_bank_statements v WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'schedules',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'revision',revision,'sourceId',source_voucher,'active',active,'nextDate',next_date,'untilDate',until_date,'frequency',frequency,'autoPost',auto_post,'lastError',last_error)) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_schedules WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'settings',coalesce((SELECT payload||jsonb_build_object('revision',revision) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_settings WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'{"revision":0,"expenseFields":[],"receiptFields":[],"custodyFields":[],"expenseAccountId":null,"receiptAccountId":null,"cashAccountId":null}'::jsonb),
 'accounts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'code',code,'kind',kind,'active',active,'frozen',frozen,'is_group',is_group,'balance',erp_finance_private.balance(p_cafe_id,id)) ORDER BY code) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'parties',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'kind',kind,'active',active)) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_parties WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'employees',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',first_name||' '||last_name,'active',active)) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_hr_employees WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'costCenters',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code,'name',name,'active',active,'is_group',is_group)) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_cost_centers WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'),
 'vatRate',(SELECT vat_rate FROM erp_branch_private.bf_settings WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'canWrite',r<>'auditor','canApprove',r<>'auditor','canSettings',r='owner');
 IF p_query->>'id' IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(answer->'vouchers')v WHERE v->>'id'=p_query->>'id') THEN answer:=jsonb_set(answer,'{vouchers}',answer->'vouchers'||coalesce((SELECT jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(v)-'cafe_id') FROM erp_branch_private.erp_finance_vouchers v WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=(p_query->>'id')::uuid),'[]'));END IF;
 RETURN erp_access_private.mask_snapshot(p_cafe_id,'finance',answer);
END $function$

 'employees',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',first_name||' '||last_name,'code',code,'userId',user_id,'branchId',branch_id,'departmentId',department_id,'designationId',designation_id) ORDER BY first_name) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_hr_employees WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND active),'[]'),

 'events',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'recordId',record_id,'action',action,'at',created_at,'detail',detail) ORDER BY id DESC) FROM(SELECT * FROM erp_branch_private.erp_payroll_events WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 300)x),'[]'),
 'loanInstallments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'loanId',loan_id,'due',due_on,'amount',amount,'repaid',repaid) ORDER BY due_on) FROM erp_branch_private.erp_payroll_loan_installments WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'[]'));

 answer:=answer||jsonb_build_object('loanPayments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'loanId',x.loan_id,'documentId',x.document_id,'amount',x.amount,'reversed',x.reversed,'payslipId',x.payslip_id) ORDER BY x.id) FROM(SELECT min(p.id::text)::uuid id,li.loan_id,p.document_id,sum(p.amount) amount,p.reversed,p.payslip_id FROM erp_branch_private.erp_payroll_loan_payments p JOIN erp_branch_private.erp_payroll_loan_installments li ON li.id=p.installment_id WHERE p.cafe_id=p_cafe_id GROUP BY li.loan_id,p.document_id,p.reversed,p.payslip_id)x),'[]'));

AS $function$DECLARE r record;used boolean;BEGIN
 FOR r IN SELECT DISTINCT ns.nspname,cl.relname,a.attname FROM pg_constraint fk JOIN pg_class cl ON cl.oid=fk.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cl.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(fk.conkey,fk.confkey) keys(local_num,target_num) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=fk.conrelid AND a.attnum=keys.local_num JOIN pg_attribute target ON target.attrelid=fk.confrelid AND target.attnum=keys.target_num WHERE fk.contype='f' AND fk.confrelid='public.branches'::regclass AND target.attname='id' AND ns.nspname='public' AND cl.relname NOT IN('erp_branch_details','erp_branch_events','erp_branch_scopes') LOOP

 END LOOP;RETURN false;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_finance_private.before_treasury_snapshot(p_cafe_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_treasury_snapshot',NULL);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_cafe_id::text,60412));
 r:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
 IF r NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.treasury_seed(p_cafe_id);
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.terminal_monthly_ensure(p_cafe_id);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  'fee_charges',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT c.*,s.number source_number,brand_finance_private.terminal_fee_paid(p_cafe_id,c.id) paid,c.total-brand_finance_private.terminal_fee_paid(p_cafe_id,c.id) remaining
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_terminal_fee_charges c LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_documents s ON s.cafe_id=c.cafe_id AND s.id=c.source_document_id WHERE c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id LIMIT 500) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'fee_charges_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_terminal_fee_charges WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'accounts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('can_delete',brand_finance_private.can_delete_cash(p_cafe_id,a.id),'balance',brand_finance_private.treasury_balance(p_cafe_id,a.id),'fees_due',brand_finance_private.terminal_fees_due(p_cafe_id,a.id),'expected_net',brand_finance_private.treasury_balance(p_cafe_id,a.id)-brand_finance_private.terminal_fees_due(p_cafe_id,a.id)) ORDER BY a.code) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_accounts a WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb),
  'reconciliations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT r.id,r.account_id,r.expected_amount expected_balance,r.counted_amount,r.difference variance,r.note,r.created_at,
   brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,r.created_by) actor_name,s.document_id adjustment_document_id
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliations r LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliation_resolutions s ON s.cafe_id=r.cafe_id AND s.reconciliation_id=r.id
   WHERE r.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'audit',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT a.id,coalesce(nullif(a.after_data->>'accountId','')::uuid,CASE WHEN a.operation IN('account_save','account_archive','account_primary','opening') THEN nullif(a.after_data->>'id','')::uuid END,d.account_id) account_id,
   a.operation,coalesce(a.after_data->>'reason',a.after_data->>'note','') note,a.created_at,brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,a.actor_id) actor_name,d.id document_id
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_audit a LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND d.id=a.entity_id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'reconciliationsTotal',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliations WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'auditTotal',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_audit WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'canCorrect',false);
END $function$

 r:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
 IF r NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset<0 OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_from>p_to OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=p_account_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid account statement'; END IF;
 WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT j.id,j.document_id,d.number,d.kind,d.created_at,d.created_by,d.note,j.debit,j.credit,
   sum(j.debit-j.credit) OVER(ORDER BY d.created_at,d.number,j.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) balance,
   (d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date posting_date
  FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND d.id=j.document_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.account_id=p_account_id
 ), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE (p_from IS NULL OR posting_date>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR posting_date<=p_to)),
 totals AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT sum(debit-credit) FROM ledger WHERE p_from IS NOT NULL AND posting_date<p_from),0) opening,coalesce(sum(debit),0) debit,coalesce(sum(credit),0) credit,count(*) total FROM selected),
 page AS (SELECT s.id,s.document_id,s.number,s.kind,s.created_at,brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,s.created_by) actor_name,s.note,s.debit,s.credit,s.balance,
  (SELECT category FROM public.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) category,
  (SELECT subcategory FROM public.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) subcategory,
  (SELECT cost_center FROM public.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) cost_center,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_treasury_documents t WHERE t.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND t.document_id=s.document_id AND t.operation IN('opening','voucher','transfer','pos_settle','pos_fee_pay') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_treasury_documents rev WHERE rev.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND rev.reverses_id=t.document_id)) can_reverse
  FROM selected s ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.number DESC,s.id DESC OFFSET p_offset LIMIT p_limit)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('opening',t.opening,'debit',t.debit,'credit',t.credit,'closing',t.opening+t.debit-t.credit,'total',t.total,'rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.number DESC,p.id DESC) FROM page p),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM totals t;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_report_relation_private.run(p_cafe_id uuid, p_query jsonb, p_export boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE q jsonb:=p_query;answer jsonb;BEGIN
 PERFORM erp_reports_private.authorize_source(p_cafe_id,q->>'source');PERFORM erp_reports_private.validate_query(q);IF p_export THEN q:=q||'{"limit":50001,"offset":0}'::jsonb;END IF;
 WITH base AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT x r FROM erp_report_relation_private.prepare(p_cafe_id,q)x WHERE x->>'date' IS NULL OR(x->>'date')::date BETWEEN(q->>'from')::date AND(q->>'to')::date),
 filtered AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r FROM base WHERE erp_report_relation_private.matches(r,q)),
 grouped AS(SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,r->k) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q->'groupBy')k),'{}') dimensions,array_agg(r) records FROM filtered GROUP BY 1),
 grouped_rows AS(SELECT dimensions||coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,erp_report_relation_private.aggregate(records,k,q)) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q->'columns')k WHERE k=ANY(erp_report_relation_private.numeric_fields(q))),'{}') r FROM grouped),
 results AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r FROM filtered WHERE NOT(q->>'summary')::boolean UNION ALL SELECT r FROM grouped_rows WHERE(q->>'summary')::boolean),
 page AS(SELECT r FROM results ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT(q->>'descending')::boolean AND q->>'sortBy'=ANY(erp_report_relation_private.numeric_fields(q)) THEN(r->>(q->>'sortBy'))::numeric END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN(q->>'descending')::boolean AND q->>'sortBy'=ANY(erp_report_relation_private.numeric_fields(q)) THEN(r->>(q->>'sortBy'))::numeric END DESC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN NOT(q->>'descending')::boolean THEN r->>(q->>'sortBy') END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN(q->>'descending')::boolean THEN r->>(q->>'sortBy') END DESC NULLS LAST,r->>'id' LIMIT(q->>'limit')::integer OFFSET(q->>'offset')::integer),
 totals AS(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,erp_report_relation_private.aggregate((SELECT array_agg(r) FROM filtered),k,q)),'{}') values FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q->'columns')k WHERE k=ANY(erp_report_relation_private.numeric_fields(q))),
 options AS(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,items),'{}') values FROM(SELECT k,(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v),'[]') FROM(SELECT DISTINCT r->>k v FROM base WHERE coalesce(r->>k,'')<>'' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 500)x)items FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((q->'columns'))k WHERE NOT(k=ANY(erp_report_relation_private.numeric_fields(q))) AND k NOT IN('note','phone','email'))x)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r->>'id','href',r->>'href')||coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,r->k) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q->'columns')k),'{}')) FROM page),'[]'),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM results),'totals',(SELECT values FROM totals),'options',(SELECT values FROM options),'from',q->>'from','to',q->>'to','generatedAt',clock_timestamp(),'basis','related_source_records_distinct_targets','hasMore',(SELECT count(*) FROM results)>(q->>'offset')::integer+(q->>'limit')::integer) INTO answer;IF p_export AND(answer->>'total')::integer>50000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='Report export exceeds 50000 rows',ERRCODE='54000';END IF;RETURN answer;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_reports_private.condition(r jsonb, p jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE field text:=p->>'field';op text:=p->>'operator';v text:=r->>field;wanted text:=p->>'value';BEGIN
 IF op='empty' THEN RETURN coalesce(v,'')='';ELSIF op='not_empty' THEN RETURN coalesce(v,'')<>'';ELSIF op='eq' THEN RETURN coalesce(v,'')=coalesce(wanted,'');ELSIF op='neq' THEN RETURN coalesce(v,'')<>coalesce(wanted,'');ELSIF op='contains' THEN RETURN position(lower(coalesce(wanted,'')) IN lower(coalesce(v,'')))>0;ELSIF op='starts' THEN RETURN left(lower(coalesce(v,'')),length(wanted))=lower(wanted);ELSIF op='ends' THEN RETURN right(lower(coalesce(v,'')),length(wanted))=lower(wanted);ELSIF op IN('gte','lte') THEN IF field=ANY(erp_reports_private.numeric_fields()) THEN IF wanted!~'^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة شرط التقرير ليست رقمًا';END IF;RETURN CASE op WHEN 'gte' THEN(v::numeric>=wanted::numeric) ELSE(v::numeric<=wanted::numeric) END;END IF;RETURN CASE op WHEN 'gte' THEN v>=wanted ELSE v<=wanted END;END IF;RAISE EXCEPTION 'معامل شرط غير صالح';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_reports_private.cost_facts(c uuid, f date, t date)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 PERFORM erp_access_private.assert_allowed(c,'accounting','read');PERFORM erp_access_private.assert_allowed(c,'finance','read');PERFORM erp_access_private.assert_allowed(c,'purchases','read');
 RETURN QUERY WITH raw AS(
  SELECT a.center_id,vd.id document_id,vd.created_at dated,'voucher'::text kind,CASE ac.kind WHEN 'revenue' THEN a.base_amount ELSE 0 END income,CASE ac.kind WHEN 'expense' THEN a.base_amount ELSE 0 END expense,0::numeric capitalized FROM public.erp_finance_cost_allocations a JOIN public.erp_finance_vouchers v ON v.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND v.id=a.voucher_id JOIN public.bf_documents vd ON vd.cafe_id=v.cafe_id AND vd.id=v.document_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=v.cafe_id AND ac.id=(v.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c
  UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,vd.id,vd.created_at,'voucher_reversal',CASE ac.kind WHEN 'revenue' THEN -a.base_amount ELSE 0 END,CASE ac.kind WHEN 'expense' THEN -a.base_amount ELSE 0 END,0 FROM public.erp_finance_cost_allocations a JOIN public.erp_finance_vouchers v ON v.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND v.id=a.voucher_id JOIN public.bf_documents vd ON vd.cafe_id=v.cafe_id AND vd.id=v.reversal_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=v.cafe_id AND ac.id=(v.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c
  UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'custody',0,a.base_amount,0 FROM public.erp_finance_custody_costs a JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements m ON m.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND m.id=a.movement_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=m.cafe_id AND d.id=m.document_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(m.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c AND ac.kind='expense'
  UNION ALL SELECT a.center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'custody_reversal',0,-a.base_amount,0 FROM public.erp_finance_custody_costs a JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements m ON m.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND m.id=a.movement_id JOIN public.erp_finance_custody_movements r ON r.cafe_id=m.cafe_id AND r.reversal_of=m.id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=r.cafe_id AND d.id=r.document_id JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(m.payload->'lines'->a.line_index->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c AND ac.kind='expense'
  UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,doc.id,doc.created_at,'journal',CASE WHEN ac.kind='revenue' THEN((l->>'credit')::numeric-(l->>'debit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN ac.kind='expense' THEN((l->>'debit')::numeric-(l->>'credit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN ac.kind IN('inventory','fixed_asset') THEN((l->>'debit')::numeric-(l->>'credit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_accounting_allocations a JOIN public.bf_gl_drafts dr ON dr.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND dr.id=a.draft_id JOIN public.bf_documents doc ON doc.cafe_id=dr.cafe_id AND doc.id=dr.document_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(dr.lines) WITH ORDINALITY lines(l,n) JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(l->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c AND n=a.line_index+1
  UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,doc.id,doc.created_at,'journal_reversal',CASE WHEN ac.kind='revenue' THEN((l->>'debit')::numeric-(l->>'credit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN ac.kind='expense' THEN((l->>'credit')::numeric-(l->>'debit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN ac.kind IN('inventory','fixed_asset') THEN((l->>'credit')::numeric-(l->>'debit')::numeric)*a.percentage/100 ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_accounting_allocations a JOIN public.bf_gl_drafts dr ON dr.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND dr.id=a.draft_id JOIN public.bf_documents doc ON doc.cafe_id=dr.cafe_id AND doc.id=dr.reversal_document_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(dr.lines) WITH ORDINALITY lines(l,n) JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND ac.id=(l->>'accountId')::uuid WHERE a.cafe_id=c AND n=a.line_index+1
  UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'purchase',0,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NULL THEN a.amount ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.amount ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND l.id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND d.id=a.document_id WHERE a.cafe_id=c
  UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'purchase_return',0,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NULL THEN -l.net ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN -l.net ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND l.reference_line_id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=l.cafe_id AND d.id=l.document_id AND d.kind='refund' WHERE a.cafe_id=c
  UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'purchase_debit',0,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NULL THEN -db.net ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN l.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN -db.net ELSE 0 END FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.erp_purchase_debits db ON db.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND db.line_id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND l.id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=db.cafe_id AND d.id=db.document_id WHERE a.cafe_id=c
 ), adjusted AS(
  SELECT * FROM raw
  UNION ALL SELECT r.center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'allocated_expense',0,-p.amount*r.expense/nullif((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=c AND j.document_id=p.expense_document_id AND a.kind='expense'),0),0 FROM public.erp_purchase_allocations p JOIN raw r ON r.document_id=p.expense_document_id AND r.expense>0 JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=p.cafe_id AND d.id=p.posting_document_id WHERE p.cafe_id=c
  UNION ALL SELECT lc.cost_center_id,d.id,d.created_at,'allocated_purchase',0,(line->>'cogs')::numeric,(line->>'inventory')::numeric FROM public.erp_purchase_allocations p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.payload->'lines')line JOIN public.erp_purchase_line_centers lc ON lc.cafe_id=p.cafe_id AND lc.line_id=(line->>'lineId')::uuid JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=p.cafe_id AND d.id=p.posting_document_id WHERE p.cafe_id=c
 ) SELECT erp_reports_private.fact(a.document_id::text||':'||a.center_id::text||':'||a.kind,(a.dated AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date,jsonb_build_object('center',cc.name,'centerId',cc.id,'kind',a.kind,'amount',sum(a.income),'cost',sum(a.expense),'value',sum(a.capitalized),'estimatedCost',0,'cashPaid',NULL)) FROM adjusted a JOIN public.erp_cost_centers cc ON cc.cafe_id=c AND cc.id=a.center_id WHERE(a.dated AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date BETWEEN f AND t GROUP BY a.document_id,a.center_id,a.kind,a.dated,cc.name,cc.id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_reports_private.financial_facts(c uuid, s text, f date, t date)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF s='sales-lines' THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT r.value FROM erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_commercial_adjustments(c,s,f,t) AS r(value)
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_document_lines l JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=l.cafe_id AND d.id=l.document_id
    JOIN public.erp_contracting_advance_invoices a ON a.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND a.invoice_id IN(d.id,d.reference_id)
    WHERE l.cafe_id=c AND l.id::text=r.value->>'id');
 ELSIF s='purchase-documents' THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT CASE WHEN n.id IS NULL THEN r.value ELSE r.value||jsonb_build_object(
   'number',n.code,'kind','إشعار دائن مشتريات','href','/dashboard/system/purchases/credit-notes/'||n.id,
   'status',CASE WHEN h.reversal_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'reversal' WHEN (r.value->>'outstanding')::numeric=0 THEN 'paid'
    WHEN (r.value->>'outstanding')::numeric<(r.value->>'amount')::numeric THEN 'partial' ELSE 'unpaid' END,
   'paid',CASE WHEN h.reversal_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE (r.value->>'amount')::numeric-(r.value->>'outstanding')::numeric END
  ) END
  FROM erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_commercial_adjustments(c,s,f,t) AS r(value)
  LEFT JOIN public.erp_purchase_credit_postings h ON h.cafe_id=c AND h.document_id::text=r.value->>'id'
  LEFT JOIN public.erp_purchase_credit_notes n ON n.cafe_id=h.cafe_id AND n.id=h.note_id;
 ELSE RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_commercial_adjustments(c,s,f,t);
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_commercial_adjustments(c uuid, s text, f date, t date)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF s<>'sales-lines' THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_deferred_cost(c,s,f,t);RETURN;END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH base AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT original.value FROM erp_reports_private.financial_facts_before_deferred_cost(c,s,f,t) AS original(value)),
 line_costs AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT actual.value FROM erp_sales_requisition_private.line_costs(c,t) AS actual(value)),
 receipts AS(SELECT lines.return_id,sum(receipt.quantity) quantity,sum(receipt.cost) cost FROM public.erp_sales_requisition_return_lines lines JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_receipts receipt ON receipt.cafe_id=c AND receipt.return_line_id=lines.id WHERE lines.cafe_id=c AND receipt.effective_on<=t GROUP BY lines.return_id),
 valued AS(
  SELECT b.value,
   sale.id IS NOT NULL OR ret.id IS NOT NULL AS deferred,
   CASE WHEN sale.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (costs.value->>'pendingQuantity')::numeric=0 THEN(costs.value->>'deliveredCost')::numeric END
    WHEN ret.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN erp_sales_requisition_private.can_read(c,ret.request_id) AND coalesce(receipts.quantity,0)=ret.financial_quantity-ret.cancelled_quantity THEN-coalesce(receipts.cost,0) END
   END AS actual_cost
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_lines sale ON sale.cafe_id=c AND sale.id::text=b.value->>'id'
  LEFT JOIN line_costs costs ON costs.value->>'sourceLineId'=sale.id::text
  LEFT JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_returns ret ON ret.cafe_id=c AND ret.refund_line_id::text=b.value->>'id'
  LEFT JOIN receipts ON receipts.return_id=ret.id
 )
 SELECT CASE WHEN deferred THEN value||jsonb_build_object('cost',actual_cost,'profit',CASE WHEN actual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN(value->>'net')::numeric-actual_cost END) ELSE value END FROM valued;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_reports_private.legacy_voucher_facts(c uuid, s text, f date, t date)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY SELECT erp_reports_private.fact(d.id::text,(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date,jsonb_build_object('number',d.number,'name',d.note,'note',d.note,'category','','account',ac.name,'customer',CASE WHEN p.kind='customer' THEN p.name ELSE '' END,'supplier',CASE WHEN p.kind='supplier' THEN p.name ELSE '' END,'net',CASE WHEN s='expenses' THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(j.debit-j.credit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=c AND j.document_id=d.id AND a.kind='expense'),0) ELSE sign*d.total-coalesce((SELECT sum(j.credit-j.debit) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=c AND j.document_id=d.id AND a.kind='vat_output'),0) END,'tax',coalesce((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN s='expenses' THEN j.debit-j.credit ELSE j.credit-j.debit END) FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.cafe_id=c AND j.document_id=d.id AND a.kind=CASE s WHEN 'expenses' THEN 'vat_input' ELSE 'vat_output' END),0),'amount',sign*d.total,'currency','SAR','status',CASE WHEN sign<0 THEN 'reversal' ELSE 'posted' END)) FROM public.bf_documents d LEFT JOIN public.bf_documents parent ON parent.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND parent.id=d.reference_id LEFT JOIN public.bf_parties p ON p.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND p.id=coalesce(d.party_id,parent.party_id) LEFT JOIN public.bf_accounts ac ON ac.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND ac.id=coalesce(d.account_id,parent.account_id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT CASE WHEN d.kind='journal' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END sign)x WHERE d.cafe_id=c AND(d.kind=CASE s WHEN 'expenses' THEN 'expense' ELSE 'receipt' END OR d.kind='journal' AND parent.kind=CASE s WHEN 'expenses' THEN 'expense' ELSE 'receipt' END) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_finance_vouchers v WHERE v.cafe_id=c AND d.id IN(v.document_id,v.reversal_id));
END $function$

 coalesce((SELECT sum(r.quantity)FROM public.erp_sales_requisition_receipts r JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_return_lines x ON x.cafe_id=c AND x.id=r.return_line_id JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_returns ret ON ret.cafe_id=c AND ret.id=x.return_id WHERE r.cafe_id=c AND ret.source_line_id=l.id AND r.effective_on<=a),0)returned,
 coalesce((SELECT sum(r.cost)FROM public.erp_sales_requisition_receipts r JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_return_lines x ON x.cafe_id=c AND x.id=r.return_line_id JOIN public.erp_sales_requisition_returns ret ON ret.cafe_id=c AND ret.id=x.return_id WHERE r.cafe_id=c AND ret.source_line_id=l.id AND r.effective_on<=a),0)returned_cost
 FROM public.erp_sales_requisition_lines l JOIN public.erp_sales_requisitions q ON q.cafe_id=c AND q.id=l.request_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=c AND d.id=q.invoice_id WHERE l.cafe_id=c AND(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE'Asia/Riyadh')::date<=a AND erp_sales_requisition_private.can_read(c,q.id))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_treasury_private.before_treasury_snapshot(p_cafe_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_treasury_snapshot',NULL);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_cafe_id::text,60412));
 r:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
 IF r NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.treasury_seed(p_cafe_id);
 PERFORM erp_treasury_private.terminal_monthly_ensure(p_cafe_id);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  'fee_charges',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT c.*,s.number source_number,brand_finance_private.terminal_fee_paid(p_cafe_id,c.id) paid,c.total-brand_finance_private.terminal_fee_paid(p_cafe_id,c.id) remaining
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_terminal_fee_charges c LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_documents s ON s.cafe_id=c.cafe_id AND s.id=c.source_document_id WHERE c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id LIMIT 500) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'fee_charges_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_terminal_fee_charges WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'accounts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)-'cafe_id'||jsonb_build_object('can_delete',brand_finance_private.can_delete_cash(p_cafe_id,a.id),'balance',brand_finance_private.treasury_balance(p_cafe_id,a.id),'fees_due',brand_finance_private.terminal_fees_due(p_cafe_id,a.id),'expected_net',brand_finance_private.treasury_balance(p_cafe_id,a.id)-brand_finance_private.terminal_fees_due(p_cafe_id,a.id)) ORDER BY a.code) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_accounts a WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb),
  'reconciliations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT r.id,r.account_id,r.expected_amount expected_balance,r.counted_amount,r.difference variance,r.note,r.created_at,
   brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,r.created_by) actor_name,s.document_id adjustment_document_id
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliations r LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliation_resolutions s ON s.cafe_id=r.cafe_id AND s.reconciliation_id=r.id
   WHERE r.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'audit',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
   SELECT a.id,coalesce(nullif(a.after_data->>'accountId','')::uuid,CASE WHEN a.operation IN('account_save','account_archive','account_primary','opening') THEN nullif(a.after_data->>'id','')::uuid END,d.account_id) account_id,
   a.operation,coalesce(a.after_data->>'reason',a.after_data->>'note','') note,a.created_at,brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,a.actor_id) actor_name,d.id document_id
   FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_audit a LEFT JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND d.id=a.entity_id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'reconciliationsTotal',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_reconciliations WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'auditTotal',(SELECT count(*) FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_audit WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),'canCorrect',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_treasury_private.before_treasury_statement(p_cafe_id uuid, p_account_id uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r text; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_treasury_statement',NULL);
 r:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
 IF r NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset<0 OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_from>p_to OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erp_branch_private.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=p_account_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid account statement'; END IF;
 WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT j.id,j.document_id,d.number,d.kind,d.created_at,d.created_by,d.note,j.debit,j.credit,
   sum(j.debit-j.credit) OVER(ORDER BY d.created_at,d.number,j.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) balance,
   (d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date posting_date
  FROM erp_branch_private.bf_journal j JOIN erp_branch_private.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND d.id=j.document_id WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.account_id=p_account_id
 ), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE (p_from IS NULL OR posting_date>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR posting_date<=p_to)),
 totals AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT sum(debit-credit) FROM ledger WHERE p_from IS NOT NULL AND posting_date<p_from),0) opening,coalesce(sum(debit),0) debit,coalesce(sum(credit),0) credit,count(*) total FROM selected),
 page AS (SELECT s.id,s.document_id,s.number,s.kind,s.created_at,brand_finance_private.treasury_actor_name(p_cafe_id,s.created_by) actor_name,s.note,s.debit,s.credit,s.balance,
  (SELECT category FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) category,
  (SELECT subcategory FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) subcategory,
  (SELECT cost_center FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_documents WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND document_id=s.document_id) cost_center,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_documents t WHERE t.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND t.document_id=s.document_id AND t.operation IN('opening','voucher','transfer','pos_settle','pos_fee_pay') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erp_branch_private.bf_treasury_documents rev WHERE rev.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND rev.reverses_id=t.document_id)) can_reverse
  FROM selected s ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.number DESC,s.id DESC OFFSET p_offset LIMIT p_limit)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('opening',t.opening,'debit',t.debit,'credit',t.credit,'closing',t.opening+t.debit-t.credit,'total',t.total,'rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.number DESC,p.id DESC) FROM page p),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM totals t;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_claim_message_status_checks(p_cafe_id uuid, p_document_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_document_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_document_ids)>100 OR array_position(p_document_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid invoice IDs' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT j.id FROM public.bf_customer_message_jobs j
  WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.document_id=ANY(p_document_ids) AND j.state='queued' AND j.provider_message_id IS NOT NULL
   AND coalesce(j.provider_status,'pending') NOT IN ('read','failed')
   AND (j.provider_checked_at IS NULL OR j.provider_checked_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')
  ORDER BY j.provider_checked_at NULLS FIRST,j.created_at,j.id LIMIT 8 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 ), claimed AS (
  UPDATE public.bf_customer_message_jobs j SET provider_checked_at=clock_timestamp(),provider_poll_token=gen_random_uuid()
  FROM eligible e WHERE j.id=e.id RETURNING j.*
 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'pollToken',j.provider_poll_token,'messageId',j.provider_message_id,'phone',s.phone)),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_result FROM claimed j JOIN public.bf_sale_customers s ON s.document_id=j.document_id AND s.cafe_id=j.cafe_id;
 RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_control_report(p_cafe_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Financial reporting permission required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WITH balances AS (
  SELECT a.kind,a.code,coalesce(sum(j.debit),0) debit,coalesce(sum(j.credit),0) credit
  FROM public.bf_accounts a LEFT JOIN public.bf_journal j ON j.account_id=a.id AND j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
  WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id GROUP BY a.kind,a.code
 ), totals AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(debit),0) debit,coalesce(sum(credit),0) credit,
   coalesce(sum(debit-credit) FILTER(WHERE kind='inventory'),0) inventory,
   coalesce(sum(credit-debit) FILTER(WHERE kind='revenue'),0) revenue,
   coalesce(sum(debit-credit) FILTER(WHERE code='5000'),0) cost,
   coalesce(sum(debit-credit) FILTER(WHERE kind='expense' AND code<>'5000'),0) expenses,
   coalesce(sum(debit-credit) FILTER(WHERE kind='vat_input'),0) vat_input,
   coalesce(sum(credit-debit) FILTER(WHERE kind='vat_output'),0) vat_output FROM balances
 ), quality AS (
  SELECT count(*) total,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.cost_status NOT IN('known','estimated') AND NOT(l.cost_status='legacy' AND l.item_id IS NOT NULL AND l.cost>0)) unknown,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.cost_status='estimated') estimated,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.cost_status='legacy') legacy
  FROM public.bf_document_lines l JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.id=l.document_id AND d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
  LEFT JOIN public.bf_documents original ON original.id=d.reference_id AND original.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
  WHERE l.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (d.kind='sale' OR (d.kind='refund' AND original.kind='sale'))
 ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('generatedAt',now(),'debit',t.debit,'credit',t.credit,
  'inventoryLedger',t.inventory,'inventoryStock',(SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) FROM public.bf_stock WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id),
  'revenue',t.revenue,'cost',t.cost,'otherExpenses',t.expenses,'bookProfit',t.revenue-t.cost-t.expenses,
  'vatInput',t.vat_input,'vatOutput',t.vat_output,'costLines',q.total,'unknownCostLines',q.unknown,'estimatedCostLines',q.estimated,'legacyCostLines',q.legacy,
  'closedThrough',(SELECT closed_through FROM public.bf_settings WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id)) INTO result FROM totals t CROSS JOIN quality q;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_finish_message_status_check(p_job_id uuid, p_poll_token uuid, p_provider_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_job public.bf_customer_message_jobs; v_accept boolean;
BEGIN
 IF p_provider_status IS NOT NULL AND p_provider_status NOT IN ('pending','sent','delivered','read','failed','yellowCard') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid provider status' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_job FROM public.bf_customer_message_jobs WHERE id=p_job_id AND provider_poll_token=p_poll_token FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 v_accept:=p_provider_status IS NOT NULL AND CASE
  WHEN v_job.provider_status='read' THEN p_provider_status='read'
  WHEN v_job.provider_status='delivered' THEN p_provider_status IN ('delivered','read')
  WHEN v_job.provider_status='sent' THEN p_provider_status IN ('sent','delivered','read','failed','yellowCard') ELSE true END;
 UPDATE public.bf_customer_message_jobs SET
  provider_status=CASE WHEN v_accept THEN p_provider_status ELSE provider_status END,
  provider_confirmed_at=CASE WHEN v_accept AND provider_status IS DISTINCT FROM p_provider_status THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE provider_confirmed_at END,
  provider_check_error=CASE WHEN p_provider_status IS NULL THEN 'status_unavailable' ELSE NULL END,
  provider_poll_token=NULL
 WHERE id=v_job.id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_gl_report(p_cafe_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date, p_account_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE start_at timestamptz; end_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_gl_enabled(p_cafe_id);
  IF brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا تملك صلاحية قراءة التقرير' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_from) OR NOT isfinite(p_to) OR p_to<p_from OR p_to-p_from>3660
    OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset<0 OR p_offset>1000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حدد فترة تقرير صالحة'; END IF;
  IF p_account_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=p_account_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الحساب غير موجود'; END IF;
  start_at:=p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'; end_at:=(p_to+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'accountId',p_account_id,'offset',p_offset,
    'generatedAt',now(),'currency','SAR',
    'balances',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(b) ORDER BY code) FROM (
      SELECT a.id,a.code,a.name,a.kind,a.parent_id,a.is_group,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit-j.credit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at<start_at),0) opening,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at>=start_at),0) debit,
        coalesce(sum(j.credit) FILTER(WHERE j.created_at>=start_at),0) credit,
        coalesce(sum(j.debit-j.credit),0) closing
      FROM public.bf_accounts a LEFT JOIN public.bf_journal j ON j.account_id=a.id AND j.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND j.created_at<end_at
      WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR a.id=p_account_id) GROUP BY a.id
    ) b),'[]'),
    'entries',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(e) ORDER BY created_at,id) FROM (
      SELECT j.id,j.document_id,j.account_id,j.debit,j.credit,j.created_at,j.memo,a.name account_name,a.code,d.number,d.kind,d.reference_id
      FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND a.id=j.account_id
      JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=j.cafe_id AND d.id=j.document_id
      WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.created_at>=start_at AND j.created_at<end_at AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR j.account_id=p_account_id)
      ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id OFFSET p_offset LIMIT 100
    ) e),'[]'),
    'hasMore',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_journal j WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.created_at>=start_at AND j.created_at<end_at
      AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR j.account_id=p_account_id) OFFSET p_offset+100 LIMIT 1));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_invoice_message_statuses(p_cafe_id uuid, p_document_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_role text; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
 v_role:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
 IF v_role NOT IN ('owner','manager','accountant','auditor','cashier') OR v_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_document_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_document_ids)>100 OR array_position(p_document_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid invoice IDs' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'documentId',d.id,
  'status',CASE WHEN j.provider_status='read' THEN 'read' WHEN j.provider_status='delivered' THEN 'delivered'
   WHEN j.provider_status='sent' THEN 'sent' WHEN j.provider_status='failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN j.provider_status='yellowCard' THEN 'review'
   WHEN j.id IS NULL THEN 'not_requested' WHEN j.state='pending' THEN 'queued' WHEN j.state='dispatching' THEN 'sending'
   WHEN j.state='queued' THEN 'queued' WHEN j.state='rejected' THEN 'failed' WHEN j.state='unknown' THEN 'review'
   WHEN j.state='cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'unknown' END,
  'reason',CASE WHEN j.provider_status='failed' THEN 'provider_failed' WHEN j.provider_status='yellowCard' THEN 'provider_suspended'
   WHEN j.provider_status IN ('delivered','read') THEN NULL WHEN j.id IS NULL AND d.customer_phone IS NULL THEN 'no_phone'
   WHEN j.id IS NULL AND NOT platform_access_private.service_enabled(d.cafe_id,'loyalty') THEN 'loyalty_unavailable'
   WHEN j.id IS NULL THEN 'not_queued' WHEN j.state='rejected' THEN 'provider_rejected' WHEN j.error_code='dispatch_expired' THEN 'dispatch_expired'
   WHEN j.state='unknown' THEN 'delivery_uncertain' WHEN j.state='cancelled' THEN 'cancelled'
   WHEN j.provider_check_error IS NOT NULL THEN 'status_unavailable' ELSE NULL END,
  'updatedAt',coalesce(j.provider_confirmed_at,j.finished_at,j.created_at,d.created_at),'checkedAt',j.provider_checked_at
 ) ORDER BY d.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result FROM public.bf_documents d
 LEFT JOIN public.bf_customer_message_jobs j ON j.document_id=d.id AND j.cafe_id=d.cafe_id
 WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND d.id=ANY(p_document_ids) AND d.kind='sale' AND (v_role<>'cashier' OR d.created_by=auth.uid());
 RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_journal_export(p_cafe_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_as_of timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_after_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_after_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE cutoff timestamptz:=coalesce(p_as_of,statement_timestamp()); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Financial reporting permission required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF length(coalesce(p_query,''))>120 OR (p_from IS NOT NULL AND p_to IS NOT NULL AND p_from>p_to) OR cutoff>statement_timestamp() OR ((p_after_time IS NULL)<>(p_after_id IS NULL)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid export filter'; END IF;
 WITH filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT j.id,j.created_at,j.document_id,d.number document_number,a.code account_code,a.name account_name,j.memo,j.debit,j.credit
  FROM public.bf_journal j JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id AND a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
  JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.id=j.document_id AND d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
  WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.created_at<=cutoff
   AND (p_from IS NULL OR j.created_at>=(p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'))
   AND (p_to IS NULL OR j.created_at<((p_to+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'))
   AND (coalesce(p_query,'')='' OR strpos(lower(a.name||' '||coalesce(j.memo,'')||' '||d.number::text),lower(p_query))>0)
 ), page AS (
  SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE p_after_time IS NULL OR (created_at,id)>(p_after_time,p_after_id) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 500
 ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('asOf',cutoff,'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
  'debit',(SELECT coalesce(sum(debit),0) FROM filtered),'credit',(SELECT coalesce(sum(credit),0) FROM filtered),
  'rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY created_at,id) FROM page p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'next',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('time',created_at,'id',id) FROM page ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$
