CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_price_list_activity(p_cafe_id uuid, p_list_id uuid, p_before_revision integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  role_name text;
  answer jsonb;
  next_cursor integer;
BEGIN
  role_name := brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id);
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR coalesce(role_name, '') NOT IN ('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_list_id IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 30 OR p_before_revision <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid activity cursor' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.id, e.revision, e.created_at, e.created_by,
      e.before_settings #> '{advanced,priceLists}' before_lists,
      e.after_settings #> '{advanced,priceLists}' after_lists
    FROM public.bf_invoice_settings_events e
    WHERE e.cafe_id = p_cafe_id AND (p_before_revision IS NULL OR e.revision < p_before_revision)
    ORDER BY e.revision DESC LIMIT 201
  ), scanned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 200
  ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.id, e.revision, e.created_at, e.created_by,
      (SELECT item FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.before_lists) = 'array' THEN e.before_lists ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE item ->> 'id' = p_list_id::text LIMIT 1) previous,
      (SELECT item FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.after_lists) = 'array' THEN e.after_lists ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE item ->> 'id' = p_list_id::text LIMIT 1) current
    FROM scanned e
  ), matching AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM selected WHERE previous IS DISTINCT FROM current ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT p_limit + 1
  ), page AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM matching ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ), projected AS (
    SELECT p.revision, jsonb_build_object(
      'id', p.id, 'revision', p.revision, 'createdAt', p.created_at,
      'actor', coalesce((SELECT nullif(s.name, '') FROM public.bf_staff s WHERE s.cafe_id = p_cafe_id AND s.user_id = p.created_by), (SELECT nullif(pr.full_name, '') FROM public.profiles pr WHERE pr.id = p.created_by), 'مستخدم غير مسمى'),
      'action', CASE WHEN p.previous IS NULL THEN 'created' WHEN p.current IS NULL THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'updated' END,
      'changes', coalesce((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('field', changes.field, 'productId', changes.product_id, 'before', changes.before_value, 'after', changes.after_value) ORDER BY changes.ordinal, changes.product_id)
        FROM (
          SELECT 'name'::text field, NULL::text product_id, p.previous -> 'name' before_value, p.current -> 'name' after_value, 1 ordinal WHERE p.previous -> 'name' IS DISTINCT FROM p.current -> 'name'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'active', NULL, p.previous -> 'active', p.current -> 'active', 2 WHERE p.previous -> 'active' IS DISTINCT FROM p.current -> 'active'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'customers', NULL, to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p.previous -> 'partyIds', '[]'::jsonb))), to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p.current -> 'partyIds', '[]'::jsonb))), 3 WHERE coalesce(p.previous -> 'partyIds', '[]'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p.current -> 'partyIds', '[]'::jsonb)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'price', coalesce(b.item ->> 'productId', a.item ->> 'productId'), b.item -> 'price', a.item -> 'price', 4
          FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p.previous -> 'prices', '[]'::jsonb)) b(item)
          FULL JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p.current -> 'prices', '[]'::jsonb)) a(item) ON a.item ->> 'productId' = b.item ->> 'productId'
          WHERE b.item -> 'price' IS DISTINCT FROM a.item -> 'price'
        ) changes
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) item
    FROM page p
  )
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY revision DESC) FROM projected), '[]'::jsonb),
    CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM matching) > p_limit THEN (SELECT min(revision) FROM page)
      WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates) > 200 THEN (SELECT min(revision) FROM scanned)
      ELSE NULL END
  INTO answer, next_cursor;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('items', answer, 'nextCursor', next_cursor, 'limit', p_limit);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_shift_analytics(p_cafe_id uuid, p_shift_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE sh public.bf_shifts%ROWTYPE; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_shift_analytics',NULL);
 IF brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) NOT IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO sh FROM public.bf_shifts WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND id=p_shift_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Shift unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 WITH sales AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (brand_finance_private.payment_document(d)).* FROM public.bf_documents d WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND d.shift_id=p_shift_id AND d.kind='sale'
 ), returns AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (brand_finance_private.payment_document(d)).* FROM public.bf_documents d JOIN sales s ON s.id=d.reference_id
  WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND d.kind='refund'
 ), settlements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (brand_finance_private.payment_document(d)).* FROM public.bf_documents d JOIN sales s ON s.id=d.reference_id
  WHERE d.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND d.kind='settlement'
 ), documents AS (
  SELECT id,created_at,1 AS direction FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT id,created_at,-1 FROM returns
 ), lines AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.*,d.direction,d.created_at,
   coalesce('p:'||l.product_id::text,'i:'||l.item_id::text,'l:'||coalesce(l.reference_line_id,l.id)::text) AS product_key,
   (l.cost_status IN('known','estimated') OR (l.cost_status='legacy' AND l.item_id IS NOT NULL AND l.cost>0)) AS cost_available
  FROM documents d JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.document_id=d.id AND l.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
 ), product_totals AS (
  SELECT product_key,(array_agg(product_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL))[1] AS product_id,
   (array_agg(item_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL))[1] AS item_id,
   (array_agg(name ORDER BY (direction=1) DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS name,
   coalesce(sum(quantity) FILTER(WHERE direction=1),0) AS sold_quantity,
   coalesce(sum(quantity) FILTER(WHERE direction=-1),0) AS returned_quantity,
   sum(quantity*direction) AS net_quantity,count(DISTINCT document_id) FILTER(WHERE direction=1) AS sales_count,
   sum(net*direction) AS revenue,sum(cost*direction) AS cost,sum(coalesce(allocated_cost,cost)*direction) AS allocated_cost,
   coalesce(sum((net-cost)*direction) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='known'),0) AS known_profit,
   CASE WHEN bool_and(cost_available) THEN sum((net-cost)*direction) END AS profit,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT cost_available) AS unknown_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='estimated') AS estimated_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='legacy') AS legacy_count
  FROM lines GROUP BY product_key
 ), product_stock AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.product_key,component.item_id,s.warehouse_id,w.name AS warehouse_name,s.quantity,i.unit,i.min_quantity
  FROM lines l JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT c.item_id FROM public.bf_line_components c WHERE c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND c.line_id=l.id
 UNION SELECT l.item_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_line_components c WHERE c.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND c.line_id=l.id)
 ) component ON true JOIN public.bf_items i ON i.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND i.id=component.item_id
  JOIN public.bf_stock s ON s.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND s.item_id=i.id
  JOIN public.bf_warehouses w ON w.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND w.id=s.warehouse_id
 ), hours AS (
  SELECT extract(hour FROM s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::integer AS hour,
   count(*) AS sales_count,sum(s.total) AS sales_total,
   sum((SELECT coalesce(sum(l.quantity),0) FROM public.bf_document_lines l WHERE l.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND l.document_id=s.id)) AS quantity
  FROM sales s GROUP BY 1
 ), payment_events AS (
  SELECT id AS sale_id,account_id,paid,0::numeric AS returned_paid FROM sales WHERE paid>0
  UNION ALL SELECT reference_id,account_id,total,0 FROM settlements
  UNION ALL SELECT reference_id,account_id,0,paid FROM returns WHERE paid>0
 ), payments AS (
  SELECT a.id,a.kind,a.name,count(DISTINCT e.sale_id) AS sales_count,sum(e.paid) AS paid,sum(e.returned_paid) AS returned_paid
  FROM payment_events e JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=e.account_id AND a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id GROUP BY a.id,a.kind,a.name
 ), line_totals AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(net*direction),0) AS revenue,coalesce(sum(cost*direction),0) AS cost,coalesce(sum(coalesce(allocated_cost,cost)*direction),0) AS allocated_cost,
   coalesce(sum((net-cost)*direction) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='known'),0) AS known_profit,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(bool_and(cost_available),true) THEN coalesce(sum((net-cost)*direction),0) END AS profit,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT cost_available) AS unknown_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='estimated') AS estimated_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='legacy') AS legacy_count,
   CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 100 ELSE round(100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_available)/count(*),2) END AS coverage,
   coalesce(sum(quantity) FILTER(WHERE direction=1),0) AS sold_quantity,
   coalesce(sum(quantity) FILTER(WHERE direction=-1),0) AS returned_quantity,
   coalesce(sum(quantity*direction),0) AS net_quantity FROM lines
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'generatedAt',now(),'shiftId',sh.id,'openedAt',sh.opened_at,'closedAt',sh.closed_at,
  'durationSeconds',greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM coalesce(sh.closed_at,now())-sh.opened_at)),
  'totals',jsonb_build_object(
   'salesCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM sales),'refundCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM returns),
   'grossSales',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) FROM sales),'returnedTotal',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) FROM returns),
   'netSales',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) FROM sales)-(SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) FROM returns),
   'netRevenue',lt.revenue,'tax',(SELECT coalesce(sum(tax),0) FROM sales)-(SELECT coalesce(sum(tax),0) FROM returns),
   'discount',(SELECT coalesce(sum(discount),0) FROM sales)-(SELECT coalesce(sum(discount),0) FROM returns),
   'cost',lt.cost,'allocatedCost',lt.allocated_cost,'allocatedProfit',CASE WHEN lt.profit IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE lt.revenue-lt.allocated_cost END,'knownProfit',lt.known_profit,'profit',lt.profit,'unknownCostLineCount',lt.unknown_count,
   'estimatedCostLineCount',lt.estimated_count,'legacyCostLineCount',lt.legacy_count,'costCoveragePercent',lt.coverage,
   'soldQuantity',lt.sold_quantity,'returnedQuantity',lt.returned_quantity,'netQuantity',lt.net_quantity,
   'averageBasket',(SELECT coalesce(round(avg(total),2),0) FROM sales),
   'offlineSalesCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM sales s WHERE to_jsonb(s)->>'local_created_at' IS NOT NULL),
   'initialCredit',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total-paid),0) FROM sales),
   'settlementPaid',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) FROM settlements)
  ),
  'products',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'key',p.product_key,'productId',p.product_id,'itemId',p.item_id,'name',p.name,
   'soldQuantity',p.sold_quantity,'returnedQuantity',p.returned_quantity,'netQuantity',p.net_quantity,'salesCount',p.sales_count,
   'revenue',p.revenue,'cost',p.cost,'allocatedCost',p.allocated_cost,'allocatedProfit',CASE WHEN p.profit IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.revenue-p.allocated_cost END,'knownProfit',p.known_profit,'profit',p.profit,
   'unknownCostLineCount',p.unknown_count,'estimatedCostLineCount',p.estimated_count,'legacyCostLineCount',p.legacy_count,
   'tracked',p.item_id IS NOT NULL,'stock',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'itemId',s.item_id,'warehouseId',s.warehouse_id,'warehouseName',s.warehouse_name,'quantity',s.quantity,'unit',s.unit,'minQuantity',s.min_quantity
   ) ORDER BY s.warehouse_name,s.warehouse_id,s.item_id) FROM product_stock s WHERE s.product_key=p.product_key),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) ORDER BY p.sold_quantity DESC,p.revenue DESC,p.product_key) FROM product_totals p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'hourly',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('hour',h,'salesCount',coalesce(t.sales_count,0),'quantity',coalesce(t.quantity,0),'salesTotal',coalesce(t.sales_total,0)) ORDER BY h) FROM generate_series(0,23) h LEFT JOIN hours t ON t.hour=h),
  'payments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId',id,'kind',kind,'accountName',name,'salesCount',sales_count,'paid',paid,'returnedPaid',returned_paid,'netPaid',paid-returned_paid) ORDER BY paid DESC,id) FROM payments),'[]'::jsonb),
  'notes',jsonb_build_object('timeBasis','server_posted_riyadh','stockBasis','current','refundBasis','linked_sales_as_of_report','paymentBasis','linked_sales_as_of_report')
 ) INTO result FROM line_totals lt;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.brand_finance_shift_monitor(p_cafe_id uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_shift_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE rows jsonb; total bigint; managed boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM brand_finance_private.assert_job_access(p_cafe_id,'brand_finance_shift_monitor',NULL);
 managed:=brand_finance_private.role_for(p_cafe_id) IN('owner','manager','accountant','auditor');
 IF NOT managed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finance manager required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 OR length(coalesce(p_query,''))>120 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid filter'; END IF;
 WITH filtered AS (
 SELECT s.*,a.name AS drawer_name,brand_finance_private.cash_employee_name(p_cafe_id,s.user_id) AS employee_name,
 CASE WHEN s.status='closed' THEN s.expected_cash ELSE (SELECT coalesce(sum(j.debit-j.credit),0) FROM public.bf_journal j WHERE j.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND j.account_id=s.account_id) END AS current_expected,
 d.last_seen_at,coalesce(d.pending_count,0) AS pending_count,coalesce(d.conflict_count,0) AS conflict_count,
 CASE WHEN s.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN s.supervisor_paused THEN 'paused' WHEN d.last_seen_at IS NULL OR d.last_seen_at<now()-interval '90 seconds' OR d.pending_count>0 THEN 'stalled' ELSE 'active' END AS monitor_status
 FROM public.bf_shifts s JOIN public.bf_accounts a ON a.id=s.account_id AND a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(last_seen_at) AS last_seen_at,sum(pending_count) AS pending_count,sum(conflict_count) AS conflict_count FROM public.bf_shift_devices WHERE shift_id=s.id) d ON true
 WHERE s.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND (p_shift_id IS NULL OR s.id=p_shift_id)
 AND (p_from IS NULL OR s.opened_at >= p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
 AND (p_to IS NULL OR s.opened_at < (p_to+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
 AND (coalesce(p_query,'')='' OR strpos(lower(concat(s.shift_number,' ',a.name,' ',brand_finance_private.cash_employee_name(p_cafe_id,s.user_id))),lower(p_query))>0)
 ), page AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY (status<>'closed') DESC,opened_at DESC,id LIMIT 50 OFFSET p_offset)
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY (status<>'closed') DESC,opened_at DESC,id) FROM page p),'[]'::jsonb),(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered) INTO rows,total;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('rows',rows,'total',total,'checkedAt',now(),
 'actions',CASE WHEN p_shift_id IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'action',action,'reason',reason,'actor_name',actor_name,'created_at',created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC) FROM public.bf_shift_supervision WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND shift_id=p_shift_id),'[]'::jsonb) END);
END $function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

 'profiles',CASE WHEN can_settings THEN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',full_name,'phone',phone) ORDER BY full_name) FROM public.customer_profiles WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe),'[]') ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
 'links',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('customerId',customer_id,'profileId',CASE WHEN can_settings THEN profile_id ELSE NULL END,'enabled',enabled AND profile_id IS NOT NULL,'priceListId',price_list_id,'revision',revision)) FROM public.erp_customer_portal_links WHERE cafe_id=p_cafe),'[]'),
 'priceListsEnabled',coalesce((cfg#>>'{advanced,priceListsEnabled}')::boolean,false),'priceLists',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x->>'id','name',x->>'name','active',x->'active','partyIds',x->'partyIds')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cfg#>'{advanced,priceLists}','[]')) x),'[]'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_purchase_cost_report(p_cafe_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date, p_center uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 PERFORM erp_purchase_private.authorize(p_cafe_id,'read');IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<p_from OR p_to-p_from>3660 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'فترة التقرير غير صالحة';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('classification','purchase_cost','currency','SAR','rows',coalesce((WITH source AS(SELECT a.cost_center_id,coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER(WHERE l.item_id IS NOT NULL),0) capitalized,coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER(WHERE l.item_id IS NULL),0) expensed,0::numeric returned FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND d.id=a.document_id JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND l.id=a.line_id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to GROUP BY a.cost_center_id
 UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,0,0,sum(l.net) FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.bf_document_lines l ON l.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND l.reference_line_id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=l.cafe_id AND d.id=l.document_id AND d.kind='refund' WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to GROUP BY a.cost_center_id
 UNION ALL SELECT a.cost_center_id,0,0,sum(n.net) FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers a JOIN public.erp_purchase_debits n ON n.cafe_id=a.cafe_id AND n.line_id=a.line_id JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=n.cafe_id AND d.id=n.document_id WHERE a.cafe_id=p_cafe_id AND(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to GROUP BY a.cost_center_id)
 SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM(SELECT cost_center_id AS "centerId",sum(capitalized) AS "capitalizedPurchases",sum(expensed) AS "expensedPurchases",sum(capitalized+expensed) AS "grossPurchases",sum(returned) AS "returnedPurchases",sum(capitalized+expensed-returned) AS "netPurchases" FROM source WHERE p_center IS NULL OR cost_center_id=p_center GROUP BY cost_center_id)x),'[]'));
END$function$
functions.name: erp_purchase_cost_report

 RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n)-'cafe_id'-'created_by'||jsonb_build_object(
  'sourceNumber',coalesce((SELECT p.number FROM public.erp_purchase_documents p WHERE p.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND p.finance_id=d.id),d.number::text),'supplierId',d.party_id,
  'outstanding',CASE WHEN n.status='posted' THEN coalesce((brand_finance_private.document_state(p_cafe,n.document_id)->>'outstanding')::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END,
  'history',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h)-'cafe_id' ORDER BY h.created_at) FROM public.erp_purchase_credit_postings h WHERE h.cafe_id=p_cafe AND h.note_id=n.id),'[]')
 ) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id) FROM public.erp_purchase_credit_notes n JOIN public.bf_documents d ON d.cafe_id=n.cafe_id AND d.id=n.source_document_id
 WHERE n.cafe_id=p_cafe AND erp_branch_private.row_allowed(p_cafe,b,to_jsonb(n)) AND erp_branch_private.row_allowed(p_cafe,b,to_jsonb(d)) AND erp_branch_private.allowed_resource(p_cafe,b,'account',(n.payload->>'expenseAccountId')::uuid)),'[]');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_customer_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^05[0-9]{8}$'
      THEN '966' || substring(regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') FROM 2)
    WHEN regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^5[0-9]{8}$'
      THEN '966' || regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
    WHEN regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^009665[0-9]{8}$'
      THEN substring(regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') FROM 3)
    WHEN regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^9665[0-9]{8}$'
      THEN regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
    ELSE NULL
  END
$function$
functions.name: normalize_customer_phone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_membership_private.invoice_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE r public.erp_membership_renewals;d public.bf_documents;BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.erp_membership_renewals WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND draft_id=NEW.draft_id FOR UPDATE;IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO d FROM public.bf_documents WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND id=NEW.document_id;IF d.party_id<>r.customer_id OR d.kind<>'sale' OR d.total<>r.invoice_total OR coalesce(NEW.snapshot->>'currency','SAR')<>'SAR' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'عميل أو إجمالي فاتورة الاشتراك لا يطابق الباقة' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 UPDATE public.erp_membership_renewals SET invoice_id=NEW.document_id WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND id=r.id;RETURN NEW;END $function$

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.refund_pending_customer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_documents d WHERE d.id=NEW.reference_id AND d.cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND d.kind='sale'
  AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.total),0) FROM public.bf_documents r WHERE r.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND r.kind='refund' AND r.reference_id=d.id)>=d.total) THEN
  UPDATE public.bf_sale_customers SET loyalty_status='refunded' WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND document_id=NEW.reference_id AND loyalty_status='pending_enrollment';
  UPDATE public.bf_customer_message_jobs SET state='cancelled',finished_at=now() WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND document_id=NEW.reference_id AND state='pending';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

AS $function$DECLARE c uuid;row_data jsonb;source uuid;reference uuid;BEGIN row_data:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;c:=(row_data->>'cafe_id')::uuid;source:=coalesce(row_data->>'source_id',row_data->>'document_id',row_data->>'id')::uuid;reference:=nullif(row_data->>'reference_id','')::uuid;IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_membership_renewals r WHERE r.cafe_id=c AND(r.invoice_id IN(source,reference) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_documents d WHERE d.cafe_id=c AND d.id=source AND d.reference_id=r.invoice_id))) THEN PERFORM erp_membership_private.sync(c);END IF;RETURN coalesce(NEW,OLD);END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_purchase_private.guard_cost_links()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='erp_cost_centers' THEN IF NEW.is_group AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND cost_center_id=OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مركز التكلفة مستخدم في المشتريات ولا يمكن تحويله إلى رئيسي';END IF;
 ELSE IF NEW.reversal_document_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.reversal_document_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_purchase_allocations WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND expense_document_id=OLD.document_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مصروف القيد موزع على المشتريات ولا يمكن عكسه مباشرة';END IF;END IF;RETURN NEW;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_settings_private.guard_advance_backing()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE c uuid:=coalesce(NEW.cafe_id,OLD.cafe_id);BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_contracting_advance_invoices a WHERE a.cafe_id=c AND erp_settings_private.advance_available(c,a.invoice_id)<0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إلغاء تحصيل دفعة مقدمة استهلكت في مستخلص' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;RETURN NULL;
END $function$

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_membership_private.finance_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE c uuid;row_data jsonb;source uuid;reference uuid;BEGIN row_data:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;c:=(row_data->>'cafe_id')::uuid;source:=coalesce(row_data->>'source_id',row_data->>'document_id',row_data->>'id')::uuid;reference:=nullif(row_data->>'reference_id','')::uuid;IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_membership_renewals r WHERE r.cafe_id=c AND(r.invoice_id IN(source,reference) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_documents d WHERE d.cafe_id=c AND d.id=source AND d.reference_id=r.invoice_id))) THEN PERFORM erp_membership_private.sync(c);END IF;RETURN coalesce(NEW,OLD);END $function$
triggers.name: erp_membership_payment_changed

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_rental_private.revenue_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE target uuid;BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_accounts WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND id=NEW.account_id AND code='4000') THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
 SELECT a.account_id INTO target FROM public.bf_documents d JOIN public.erp_rental_invoice_accounts a ON a.cafe_id=d.cafe_id AND a.document_id=coalesce(d.reference_id,d.id) WHERE d.cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND d.id=NEW.document_id;
 IF target IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.account_id:=target;END IF;RETURN NEW;
END $function$
triggers.name: erp_rental_revenue

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION brand_finance_private.staff_role_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bf_shifts s WHERE s.cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND s.status IN('open','handover') AND (s.user_id=OLD.user_id OR s.handover_to=OLD.user_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'أغلق وردية الموظف وأكمل تسليم عهدته قبل تغيير دوره';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
triggers.name: bf_staff_role_guard

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_access_private.guard_settings_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF public.is_platform_admin() THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF OLD.cafe_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.cafe_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Service tenant cannot change' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF platform_access_private.service_enabled(NEW.cafe_id,'settings') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

 IF pg_trigger_depth()>1
  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['owner_name','owner_phone','owner_email','updated_at'])
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['owner_name','owner_phone','owner_email','updated_at'])
  AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM brand_onboarding_private.accounts a
   JOIN public.cafes c ON c.id=a.cafe_id AND c.owner_user_id=a.owner_id
   JOIN public.profiles admin ON admin.id::text=a.pending_edit->>'actor'
     AND admin.role='platform_admin' AND admin.status='active'
   JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=a.owner_id
   WHERE a.cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND a.state='ready' AND c.status='active' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND a.pending_edit->>'id'=u.raw_app_meta_data->>'admin_brand_edit_id'
    AND a.pending_edit->>'proof'=u.raw_app_meta_data->>'admin_brand_edit_proof'
    AND u.raw_app_meta_data->>'admin_brand_edit_attempt' IS NOT NULL
    AND regexp_replace(coalesce(u.phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g')=coalesce(a.pending_edit->'details'->>'phone','')
    AND NEW.owner_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (a.pending_edit->'details'->>'ownerName')
    AND NEW.owner_phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (a.pending_edit->'details'->>'phone')
    AND NEW.owner_email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (a.pending_edit->'details'->>'email')
  ) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Service unavailable for current subscription' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END $function$
triggers.name: package_settings_write

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_rast_reward_terms()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.source_type='loyalty' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cafes WHERE id=OLD.cafe_id)
    AND (ROW(NEW.cafe_id,NEW.source_type,NEW.source_id,NEW.reward_definition_id,
      NEW.reward_title,NEW.reward_description,NEW.reward_code,NEW.qr_payload,NEW.issued_at,NEW.expires_at)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.cafe_id,OLD.source_type,OLD.source_id,OLD.reward_definition_id,
      OLD.reward_title,OLD.reward_description,OLD.reward_code,OLD.qr_payload,OLD.issued_at,OLD.expires_at)
      OR (NEW.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.customer_id)
      OR (NEW.loyalty_card_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.loyalty_card_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.loyalty_card_id)
      OR NEW.metadata->'termsSnapshot' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.metadata->'termsSnapshot') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Issued reward terms are immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.name: preserve_rast_reward_terms

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_finance_private.center_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN IF NEW.is_group AND NOT OLD.is_group AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_finance_cost_allocations WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND center_id=NEW.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_finance_custody_costs WHERE cafe_id=NEW.cafe_id AND center_id=NEW.id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المركز مستخدم في سندات مالية ولا يمكن تحويله إلى رئيسي';END IF;RETURN NEW;END $function$
triggers.name: erp_finance_center_guard

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_purchase_private.guard_cost_links()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='erp_cost_centers' THEN IF NEW.is_group AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_purchase_line_centers WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND cost_center_id=OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مركز التكلفة مستخدم في المشتريات ولا يمكن تحويله إلى رئيسي';END IF;
 ELSE IF NEW.reversal_document_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.reversal_document_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_purchase_allocations WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND expense_document_id=OLD.document_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مصروف القيد موزع على المشتريات ولا يمكن عكسه مباشرة';END IF;END IF;RETURN NEW;
END$function$
triggers.name: erp_purchase_center_guard

BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_files WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND record_id=OLD.id AND entity_type=TG_ARGV[0]) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'احذف مرفقات السجل قبل حذفه' USING ERRCODE='23503';
 END IF;
 RETURN OLD;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp_file_private.prevent_orphans()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_files WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND record_id=OLD.id AND entity_type=TG_ARGV[0]) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'احذف مرفقات السجل قبل حذفه' USING ERRCODE='23503';
 END IF;
 RETURN OLD;
END $function$
triggers.name: erp_file_orphan_guard

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.erp_files WHERE cafe_id=OLD.cafe_id AND record_id=OLD.id AND entity_type=TG_ARGV[0]) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'احذف مرفقات السجل قبل حذفه' USING ERRCODE='23503';

END $function$

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.issue_loyalty_reward_instance_from_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_card public.loyalty_cards%ROWTYPE;
  v_program public.cafe_loyalty_programs%ROWTYPE;
  v_code text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.event_type <> 'stamp' OR COALESCE(NEW.reward_delta, 0) <= 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.customer_reward_instances
    WHERE source_type = 'loyalty'
      AND source_id = NEW.id
  ) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_card
  FROM public.loyalty_cards
  WHERE id = NEW.card_id
    AND cafe_id = NEW.cafe_id
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_card.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_program
  FROM public.cafe_loyalty_programs
  WHERE cafe_id = NEW.cafe_id
    AND enabled = true
  LIMIT 1;

  v_code := public.make_customer_reward_code('LOY');

  INSERT INTO public.customer_reward_instances (
    cafe_id,
    customer_id,
    loyalty_card_id,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    reward_definition_id,
    reward_title,
    reward_description,
    reward_code,
    qr_payload,
    metadata
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.cafe_id,
    v_card.customer_profile_id,
    v_card.id,
    'loyalty',
    NEW.id,
    v_program.reward_product_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_program.reward_name, ''), 'مكافأة ولاء'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_program.reward_name, ''), 'مكافأة ولاء'),
    v_code,
    'BARNDAKSA_REWARD:' || v_code,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'loyalty_card_event',
      'cardCode', v_card.card_code,
      'eventId', NEW.id,
      'purchasesRequired', v_program.purchases_required
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.name: trg_issue_loyalty_reward_instance_from_event

triggers.functionDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pager_private.remember_customer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO public.pager_customers(cafe_id,phone) VALUES(NEW.cafe_id,NEW.phone) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

SELECT id,
    cafe_id,
    name,
    active,
    payload,
    revision
   FROM erp_att_policies source
  WHERE NULLIF(current_setting('erp.branch_cafe'::text, true), ''::text) IS DISTINCT FROM cafe_id::text OR erp_branch_private.row_allowed(cafe_id, erp_branch_private.current_branch_before_provider_payment(cafe_id), to_jsonb(source.*), ''::text);
views.name: erp_att_policies
